time_log2 is the worst-case operation count of the algorithm of proof.md section 4 (one centre, K = 1, the trial charged in full with stage D for every remainder sequence and the root isolation at its cap of 64 rounds, one thread), plus the offline bound of 1,000,000 operations of proof.md section 6.2, which is declared as preprocessing_log2 = 20 and is inside time_log2 (one quantity); memory_log2_bytes is the footprint. This entry is our filed r = 8 entry with ONE change: stage C (the powering S^((p-1)/2) mod g) is computed in the value domain on K cosets of size h = 2^24 of the order-h subgroup (bradcush 4bcabff8, proof.md section 4.3V), which lowers the stage C operation count from 1,056,612,093,561,642 to 446,444,428,530,905; every other ledger row (A, B, D worst-case, E, F, G, init, output) and the memory are unchanged. N_max = 1,527,039,469,464,147 operations. Cost model orchard-field-ram-v2: every field operation, load, store, control operation and random word is priced 1/C, C = 216 + 21 r = 384.

success_probability 0.39009 is a probability over the algorithm's fresh independent uniform 256-bit random words (the cost model's random-word primitive) for the fixed target, derived from the one score-critical premise H-ONE as 1 - (1 - q)^K - K (eps_coin + eps_iso) = q - eps_coin - eps_iso with K = 1 and q = 0.3901 (proof.md sections 9.1, 9.2). The value-domain stage C reproduces R = S^((p-1)/2) mod g exactly (KAT vd_kat.py against the coefficient-domain X^E mod g), so the premise, the success bound and stage D are unchanged.

heuristics.statement: SEE filed r8 entry claim.json heuristic H-ONE (unchanged): the number of centres c in F_p with 1 <= k(c) <= 16 is at least 0.3901 p; with K = 1 the success bound is q - eps_coin - eps_iso = 0.390099999999997628. The value-domain stage C of this entry changes only how R = S^((p-1)/2) mod g is computed (the coset powering of bradcush 4bcabff8), not R itself, so H-ONE, its role, scope, extrapolation, evidence and limitations are identical to the filed r8 entry.
heuristics.scope: The fixed Poseidon target poseidon-orchard-r8-prefix-v1, this line construction, centres uniform on F_p. Not claimed for other round counts. Stage D is charged for every remainder sequence (proof.md 6.3), so no premise on the sequences is used; the value-domain stage C is a program change under the declared cost model, not a heuristic.
heuristics.extrapolation: From the law of k(c) at reduced depth to the polynomial F of depth 12. The roots of G(c,t) in t are +-t_1, ..., +-t_m, so the monodromy group of the cover lies in the hyperoctahedral group B_m and k(c) counts the positive fixed points of the Frobenius element; for the full group B_m this number is Poisson(1/2) in the limit, P(k >= 1) = 1 - e^(-1/2) = 0.3934693 (exactly 1 - sum_{j<=m} (-1/2)^j/j!), and Bonferroni at order 4 gives P >= 151/384 = 0.3932292 from four moments (proof.md 9.3(a), (b)). At N = 2 and 3 S-box layers on the deployed constants and the attack line the arithmetic monodromy is B_12 and B_62 (Grok jobs 136 and 137, re-run on the deployed constants, proof.md 10.3); the geometric monodromy then contains the commutator subgroup of B_m, the j-fold fibre powers are absolutely irreducible, and the Aubry-Perret bound with Bonferroni gives 0.39346933 <= P(1 <= k <= 16) <= 0.39346944 there: the premise is a theorem at those depths (proof.md 9.3(c)). Measured: toy fields at p = 1,048,627, exact over all centres, 27 cases with 3 to 8 layers, P(k >= 1) between 0.39214 and 0.39436 (proof.md 9.3(d)); the organizer-run tests one-centre-n2-t256 and one-centre-n3-t24 run one trial of the algorithm at depth N = 2, 3 (m = 12, 62) per organizer seed and return a witness pair exactly when the sequence is normal, 1 <= k(c) <= 16 and the isolated root gives a verified collision of F_N, with predicted counts Binomial(T, 0.393469) (proof.md 10.5.1). The deviations from the law shrink like p^(-1/2) and do not grow with the degree (toy fields 1.36/sqrt(p); the counts of Grok job 139, eps ~ 3.1/sqrt(p) over degrees 5 to 1,953,125); the premise extrapolates the law to N = 14 with an allowance of 0.0034.
heuristics.limitations: As the filed r8 entry. The value-domain stage C adds no premise: coset distinctness is a closed-form certificate (proof.md 4.3V, the 2K cosets 5^0 H..5^(2K-1) H are distinct because 5^(d h) != 1 for 1 <= d <= 2K-1 and ord(5^h) = (p-1)/h >= 2K), and the equality of the value-domain and coefficient-domain R is a KAT.
